version.description: The Groundwork version that installed or last upgraded this project's .groundwork/ files. Written by `groundwork init` and `groundwork upgrade`; `groundwork doctor` compares it with the CLI.

approvalMode.description: per-card: the human approves every card before it is committed. per-phase: cards commit after review passes, and the human approves the phase as a whole.

experience.description: How much the agent explains. new: one sentence per step, How to check at every approval stop, a labeled recommendation for stack choices. experienced: terse, a short approval summary, options only unless asked. Read fresh each time, so it can change mid-project.

tokenBudget.description: Maximum estimated tokens for files loaded in every session (AGENTS.md plus always-on adapter files). Checked by `groundwork doctor`.

guards.description: Guards to run before shell commands and file writes, by file name in .groundwork/guards/ (without .mjs). Empty means none run.

models.description: Optional model per role, used only by adapters (the core ignores it). A value is one model name for every tool, or an object with one name per adapter (keyed by the adapter's name, as in `groundwork adapter add`), since each tool names models its own way. Leave a role out to use the tool's default.

commitFormat.description: The first line of each card's commit. {id} is the card ID and {title} its title, e.g. "feat: {title} ({id})". Quick changes use "quick" as the ID. Default: "[{id}] {title}".

commands.description: Shell commands the agents run. Leave a command empty if the project doesn't have it.

run.description: How to start the app so a person or an agent can use it, e.g. a local server. Roles use it to check a card in the running app; stop summaries use it for How to check.
